about: GTA 6 loot as an escape room: a player's early-game loot run (TikTok @diez.gg, posted 2026-11-20, the day after launch) shows one cash bag behind a chain of four locks: reach a compound by boat, turn the power on, find the PC password in the bedroom, the PC gives the safe code, the safe holds another code that opens a shed by the water with a cash bag (10-30K, he says) and a rare SMG; the bag is sold to Brian. Commentary mode (SAFE-EDIT rule 10): three muted creator clips, facecam and captions cropped out, each annotated, credit in the description only. Delta.

lines.text: In GTA 6, one cash bag sits behind four locks.
lines.say: In G T A six, one cash bag sits behind four locks.

lines.text: A player posted the chain, a day after launch.
Boat out to a compound. Lock one: turn the power on.
Lock two: the PC password is hidden in the bedroom.

lines.text: Lock three: the PC gives you the safe code.
lines.say: Lock three: the P C gives you the safe code.

lines.text: Three steps for one safe. Rockstar built a puzzle box.
Inside the safe? Barely any cash. Just another code.
Lock four: a shed by the water.
Inside, a bag worth ten to thirty grand, he says.
Plus a rare SMG, he says.
lines.say: Plus a rare S M G, he says.
